svg.text: Quantum layer distributes MH-USS keys. Classical layer carries Algorithm 1.
Signer draws K² = (N−1)² field elements from 256-bit simulated keys.
Pᵢ receives keys [(i−1)K+1 … iK] and forwards the j-th element to Pⱼ as rᵢ→ⱼ.
Client REQUEST → primary L = r mod N → PRE-PREPARE of h(p).
Secondaries VOTE h(p) or ⊥ to L. Fast mode if votes ≥ 3f+1 before T.
Otherwise standard mode: PRE-COMMIT, PRE-RESOLVE, each needing ≥ 2f+1.
FEEDBACK after ≥ f+1 resolution votes. A silent primary ends on an empty block.
f = ⌊(N−1)/3⌋. Timeouts satisfy T₁ < T₂ − T (5 < 9 − 3).
Block 1024 bytes · transaction 256 bytes · 4 transactions per block · modulus 2³¹−1
Primary rotation and both modes are executed in src/qsbft/protocol.py.
